summary: First test iteration for Sertex AI assistant. All backend endpoints (13/13 pytest passed) and frontend flows verified end-to-end. GPT-5.2 chat with multi-turn memory works (Sertex correctly recalled 'Tony' in second turn). TTS returns real MP3 bytes (>1KB, audio/mpeg, ID3/MPEG magic bytes). Notes/reminders CRUD, weather mock, conversation history, language toggle (TR<->EN), new chat, history persistence, holographic sphere canvas rendering all work. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: logger is defined AFTER it is referenced inside chat/tts exception handlers (basicConfig + logger = getLogger appear at end of file, but `logger.error` is called in earlier route handlers). At runtime this works because handlers execute after module load, but stylistically the logger should be defined near the top before use.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is initialized at the bottom of the file (after route definitions). It works because routes only execute after module import, but move logger init to the top for clarity and to avoid future NameError risks if code is refactored.

server.py: For multi-turn chat, prior history is injected as one big context message in every request (LlmChat is re-created per request). This works but grows token cost linearly with conversation length. Consider truncating to last N turns (already partially done with [-20:]) or using session-scoped LlmChat if the library supports persistent sessions.
server.py: TTS text is silently truncated to 4000 chars. Consider returning a 400 with message when text is too long, or documenting the limit in the response.

server.py: Delete endpoints (/notes/{id}, /reminders/{id}, /conversations/{id}) always return 200 with deleted count 0 for non-existent ids. Consider returning 404 for missing resources to align with REST conventions.
SertexMain.jsx: `speak` calls ttsApi.synthesize which likely creates blob URL each time; ensure cleanup of previous URL to avoid memory leaks (verify in api.js).

Sidebar.jsx: Delete buttons rely on hover-triggered opacity change (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100). This is inaccessible for keyboard/touch users. Consider making them always visible or focusable.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed notes/reminders and self-clean via delete. Chat test conversation is deleted at end of TestChat class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 8 endpoint groups plus multi-turn memory validation and TTS MP3 byte validation. Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for API calls and all interactive elements have data-testid attributes. UI labels apply CSS uppercase text-transform, so use case-insensitive matching when asserting text content.
